extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: MTEB spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. Through the benchmarking of 33 models on MTEB, we establish the most comprehensive benchmark of text embeddings to date.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.inLanguage: eng, fra, rus, deu, zho, spa, ita, nld, ara, pol, tur, kor
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB aggregates existing datasets and creates custom datasets using public APIs from arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, Reddit, and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, and available data from Reddit and StackExchange posts.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For S2S datasets, the input text is the title of the paper, while for P2P the input text is the concatenation of the title and the abstract. Cluster labels are generated using categories given to the papers by humans.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Subsets of all labels are selected and articles are sampled from those labels to yield splits with varying amounts and sizes of clusters.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Cluster labels are generated using categories given to the papers by humans. For bioRxiv and medRxiv this category is unique, but for arXiv multiple categories can be given to a single paper so only the first one is used.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The benchmark is versioned at a dataset and software level to ensure reproducibility, and community contributions are welcomed via pull requests to continue development.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include the absence of very long document datasets, task imbalance (e.g., summarization has only one dataset), and limited multilinguality in certain tasks (retrieval and clustering are English-only).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking text embedding models across 8 tasks: Bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: 1. Long document datasets MTEB covers multiple text lengths (S2S, P2P, S2P), but very long documents are still missing... 2. Task imbalance Tasks in MTEB have a different amount of datasets with summarization consisting of only a single dataset... 3. Multinguality MTEB contains multilingual classification, STS and bitext mining datasets. However, retrieval and clustering are English-only.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: MTEB aims to provide an understanding of the usability of embedding models in various use cases. The benchmark comprises 8 different tasks: Bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS and summarization.
